## basics

::: {.cv-entry}
::: {.cv-entry__when}
Ankara, Türkiye
:::
::: {.cv-entry__what}
**Mehmet Fatih Kara**

Plant scientist working on the genetics of disease resistance in lettuce, and how
that response can be read at the level of individual transcripts rather than whole
genes. PhD researcher at the University of York.

[info@mfkara.net](mailto:info@mfkara.net) ·
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0318-228X) ·
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?&user=56zv2gQAAAAJ) ·
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/m-f-kara)
:::
:::

**PhD, Department of Biology** · [University of York](https://www.york.ac.uk/)

Genetic basis of lettuce resistance to the necrotrophic fungi *Botrytis cinerea*
and *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*, combining time-series transcriptomics, reference
transcriptome construction and CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing.

## experience

::: {.cv-entry}

TODO – present
:::
::: {.cv-entry__what}
**PhD Researcher** · University of York

- Built [LsRTDv1](../research/index.qmd), a reference transcript dataset enabling
  accurate transcript-specific expression analysis in lettuce.
- Time-series transcriptomics of the lettuce response to necrotrophic infection.
- CRISPR-Cas9 editing to test candidate regulators of resistance.
:::
